svg.text: OWEN — the genre-standard figure, with small distinctions
Standard genre build: big round head, bean body, thick soft tubes, warm cream, soft outline. Ours: his face, no clothes, the amber thread shadow.
a still in this style: the Pull at his back, tied to the phone
FACE (heavy lids at rest: an adult, not a kid)
The whole rig: head (2 eyes, 2 lids, 2 brows, mouth), body, 4 tubes. A pose is 8 joint angles.
Ours: his face (thin short brows, a highlight, no eye bags at rest), no clothes, and the amber shadow tied by a thread that takes his eyes at stage 4.
